question: Do the registration, renewal, transfer-in and Discount Program figures of domains-dns/namesilo still match NameSilo's price lists?
why: The product lists and the pricing page read on 2026-11-02 show .com at USD 19.99 for registration and renewal and USD 11.50 for transfer-in, with USD 12.00 at the Discount Program 0+ first-year tier, and .uk at USD 2.25 for the first year against USD 6.49 regular; the record holds USD 17.29, USD 17.29, USD 10.80, USD 11.05 and USD 6.49. The registration, renewal and transfer-in lists match the record for .org, .net, .xyz, .top, .de, .eu, .cc and .vip. The public registration and renewal price endpoints answered a bot challenge on the default route and returned no content on each pinned read that answered, so the Discount Program renewal tiers could not be re-read; the figures in notes, chaining, limits and price_per_tb_month need one consistent refresh.
